title: A group without fixed price
main_claim: For Γ = F(a,b_1..b_99) *_J (J×⟨t⟩), where J = ⟨b_1..b_99, w=ab_1…ab_99a⟩, the Bernoulli action has cost ≥ 1+η (η=α/100, Kα^3<1/2, α<1/200). The height extensions Y_M = X×Z/M, with height via χ(a)=1, have cost ≤ 1+99/M. So Γ does not have fixed price, which is a negative answer to Gaboriau's question.
coverage:
I read every section of the LaTeX source and checked each step:
(1) Normal form and the upper bound. The marker set C_p plus a-edges on 99 height fibers propagate to all heights through w = u_99 a; the induction over k = 0..M-100 is correct.
(2) Compression lemma. Checked the deleted-edge accounting, including disjointness of V_i^+ and φ^{-1}(V_i^-) by the distance argument; the push-forward f; the bound κ(S;Y) ≤ λ(M); and the recovery Q = T ∨ F.
(3) Deployment. The telescoping C(E_A)+C(E_B) ≤ c−1+κ(S_n)+ε is correct. S_∞ = R̄_J follows from amalgam normal form, κ(S_n)→0, and T_A = R_A after projection. Sanity checks: this is a general inequality Cost(A*_J B) ≥ 1+δ for infinite J. It is consistent with F_2 (tight), with BS(2,2) and Z×F_2, and with δ ≤ Cost(R_A)−1, which follows from the compression lemma itself.
(4) Transfer to finite models. θ is a cocycle trivial on J, so a valid path from x to xa expresses x_v from the listed edge labels. The cylinder approximation, the local law ρ_k(F), and taking the expectation over the labelling all check out.
(5) Random models. Recomputed the expansion bound C(n,s)C(n,95s)(96s/n)^{99s} ≤ [K(s/n)^3]^s with K = e^96·96^99/95^95 ≈ 10^50, so α ≈ 1.6e-17 is admissible. Also checked the fixed-point estimate, and that a bad row forces a fixed point of the nontrivial word u_i u_k^{-1} u_l u_j^{-1}.
(6) Planar word lemma. Checked: Euler count Σ(2−c(v)) ≥ 2; the face weights ≤ ℓ−2; gap costs 1+(h−1)/3; positive vertices yielding either a full match or a bigon string of ≥ m−3; connectedness via injectivity of H→D; and exclusion of monogons and of same-relator dipoles.
(7) Rank theorem. Saturation counts are correct: 100b + 90β < 2αn, and 2αn + 90s < 96s since αn < 2s, which contradicts expansion. The final |S| ≤ 92αn < n. The relative presentation over the actual subgroup H is valid. Linear H-reduction holds by the slide-and-fold argument. The seam handling leaves an intact interval of ≥ 88 matched letters. The complement word has length ≤ 12, and the shortened segment I has ≥ 31 edges. Q_1 and Q_2 avoid I because exterior indices are distinct. The edge count drops by ≥ 19 at the same β, contradicting minimality.
I found no unjustified step, constant error, or misapplied hypothesis.
